query: Which concrete fairness mitigation techniques (post-hoc calibration, calibrated equalized odds, cost-sensitive loss, per-accent calibration layers) balance disparity reduction and overall performance best?

response.query: Which concrete fairness mitigation techniques (post-hoc calibration, calibrated equalized odds, cost-sensitive loss, per-accent calibration layers) balance disparity reduction and overall performance best?
response.answer: Cost-sensitive loss and calibrated equalized odds balance disparity reduction and overall performance best. Per-accent calibration layers are less commonly used for this purpose. Post-hoc calibration is effective but can vary in performance.
